description: Send feedback about squirrelscan to the team: a bug, a missing feature, what worked, something confusing, missing report data, or tool ergonomics. Use it when the user asks to report something. Works with any authenticated credentials, including read-only API keys.

category.description: bug_report (a defect in squirrelscan itself — wrong or missing rule result, crash, broken tool), feature_request (something squirrelscan should do but doesn't), what_worked (something worked well), confusing (unclear response/behavior), missing_data (a report or tool response was missing something you needed), tool_ergonomics (awkward tool shape/args/naming), or other.

run_id.description: Audit run id this feedback relates to, if any (from run_audit/get_report). Verified against your credentials' runs before being attached.

website_id.description: Website id this feedback relates to, if any (from list_websites). Verified against your org's websites before being attached.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
